comparison: Before is the immutable v2 run scored under the same base plan. After uses the same 27 input hashes and provider settings; prompt/context code is the intended treatment.
runtime_isolation: The runner receives only the dataset, public taxonomy, frozen protocol, and optional simulated-history bank. Evaluator labels remain evaluator_only.
failure_rule: Retain every failed provider/tool/workflow result. Never retry an uncertain prior provider effect.
limitations: Simulated history is not real confirmed history and is reported separately.
Actual provider billing, human approval time, labor time, and production incidents are not measured.
A separate newly frozen sample is required for generalization; this same-snapshot run measures regression only.
